# new_compute: Stores the generated TVM compute code.
# sch: Contains all valid schedules generated by the Polyhedral Feasibility Test (PFT).
# after_pluto: Holds the C code generated using the best schedule selected.

# To use PFT:
# 1. Modify the PFT.sh script to ensure the PFT path is correctly set.
# 2. Run the script using the following command:

bash PFT.sh

# The TVM compute code will be generated in the new_compute directory.
# Navigate into this subdirectory and run the following command:

python3 {kernel_name}.py {size}

# - {kernel_name}: The name of your C source file without the .c extension.
# - {size}: The problem size (e.g., an integer specifying the input size).
